history.name: The record is checked every time it is opened
history.description: Every command validates the whole record before it does anything: that each feature has a name, a readership, an area that exists and a size the scale recognises; that no two features share an identity; that every version referred to is a real release; that the timeline runs from one with no gaps and has exactly one release open at its end. A record that has been damaged is reported the moment it is touched rather than at the point something is being printed for a client.
history.dev_notes: Feature#validate, FeatureSet#validate and ReleaseSet#validate, all run from Project#load().
